title: Plan cache and RLS: cached plans are re-validated when the executing role changes
issue: RLS plans depend on the current role (rewriteRoleId); a cached plan is re-planned when the role differs from the one it was built for. Alternating roles (anon/authenticated) on prepared statements therefore re-plans more than expected; a generic plan with a subject-dependent policy can also be wrong for the next subject.
symptom: alt_* queries (role alternates every iteration) are slower than same_* (one role) by the planning cost of the statement, growing with partition count (flat table vs 64 partitions) and with policy complexity. force_custom_plan variants show the cost of planning every time.

scale.meaning: rows in app.documents and app.documents_p (64 hash partitions); each query runs a 500-iteration PL/pgSQL loop of PK lookups (see schema.sql).
